cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): A fundamental, ineffable principle or way that underlies and governs the universe.
cards.Nuance (English): Implies something beyond ordinary human understanding, often associated with the Daoist concept of the Dao.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Dao that can be spoken of is not the eternal Dao; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): A physical or metaphorical route taken by a person or thing.
cards.Nuance (English): Often used in the context of travel or journey.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The path is distant and dangerous, not to be taken lightly.|This road leads to the mountain top; one should walk slowly.|Travelling on this path, one is undeterred by wind and rain.|Ancient people said: the wise take pleasure in water, the benevolent in mountains; yet those who travel must first know the way.
cards.Sentences: 道遠而險，不可輕行。|此道通向山頂，宜緩步而行。|行於此道，風雨無阻。|古人雲：知者樂水，仁者樂山；然行道者，必先識途。
